gr_list.description: Migration 052: data_lists + list_records (Outbound domain, tenant_id scoped). NO partition columns (Codex: dropped). data_lists(tenant_id FK tenant_registry, name, active, source, status importing|ready|failed, total_records, sendable_count, created/updated/deleted_at; UNIQUE(tenant_id,id) for composite FK; unique index on (tenant_id, lower(trim(name))) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL). list_records(list_id+tenant_id composite FK -> data_lists(tenant_id,id) ON DELETE CASCADE, normalized_phone NULLABLE, name/surname/email/tags/note/field1-5, custom_fields JSONB, sendable BOOL default false, invalid_reason, first_contact_at; CHECK(sendable=false OR normalized_phone IS NOT NULL); UNIQUE(list_id, normalized_phone)). Idempotent IF NOT EXISTS + DO $verify$ (INV-SEED-052) + GRANT ALL (project canon, codex-context.md L20/L69 — Codex least-privilege suggestion REJECTED). arch/db/outbound.sql canonical mirror.

Outbound contact-list backend: Shared DataListDtos + ContactListOptions (reuse BulkSendOptions allowlist gate + MaxRecordsPerList cap + MaxInputRows ceiling) + DataListRepository (tenant-scoped CRUD, unnest batch insert, records-exists batch, recompute-after-batch counters as single UPDATE=SELECT COUNT, soft delete, import-status transitions) + ContactListImportService (4 scenarios w/ DETERMINISTIC merge rules, file+DB dedup, PhoneNormalizer reuse, per-list cap reject — NO partition) + 6 endpoints (GET/POST /api/v1/data-lists, PATCH/DELETE /data-lists/{id}, POST /data-lists/records/exists, POST /data-lists/import). Import wrapped so a failure leaves list status='failed' (not a half-built 'ready' list); retry-idempotent.

List -> Phase 0 bulk send via NEW POST /api/v1/bulk-send/preview-from-list. Builds the immutable bulk_send_recipients snapshot (reuses Phase 0 CreatePreviewJob path) inside a transaction, ONLY from sendable+deduped records of a list in status='ready', under the current bulk-send cap; REJECTS if over cap (INV-OB-052 no-sendable / cap handling) and rejects non-ready/deleted lists (INV-OB-051). Returns Phase 0 preview shape + rich counts (in_list/sendable/deduped/snapshotted; compliance opt-out/KVKK noted as enforced at dispatch). Existing preview/confirm/status + BulkSendConfirmRequest UNCHANGED.

Dashboard SPA DataImportPage.tsx ported from TONIVA (3-step wizard: upload -> map+scenario -> summary+execute). Client CSV+Excel parse via SheetJS HARDENED (pinned version in lockfile, file-size cap, row cap before parse, single-sheet only, headers whitelisted/normalized, values treated as text, CSV/formula-injection escape on any re-emit). 4 scenarios + dedup/normalize preview + batch execute w/ progress + 'Send to this list' -> preview-from-list. localStorage key invekto_import_jobs. App.tsx route + Layout.tsx nav (auth-gated) + lib/api.ts client. ZERO 'toniva' string.

plan.summary: FEAT-OBI Phase 1A: port TONIVA's 'Data' contact-list import page into Invekto. New tenant-scoped data_lists + list_records layer in the Outbound service, CSV/Excel client-side upload with 4 import scenarios + dedup + per-list cap (no partition), and list->bulk-send wiring via a snapshot-preserving preview-from-list endpoint. Backend reimplemented in .NET 8 + PostgreSQL; the React page ported from TONIVA and fully rebranded. Export Manager is split into Plan B (deferred).

plan.interview_notes: 3-batch interview + Codex plan review (codex_consult). DECISIONS: new tenant-scoped contact-list layer in Outbound; client-side SheetJS Excel parse (no .NET dep); extended fields phone(req)+name+surname+email+tags+note+field1-5+custom_fields JSONB; TONIVA's 4 import scenarios (new_only/recall_all/update_info/custom), 'callable'->'sendable'; list->send wired NOW via preview-from-list; done bar = backend + UI render + auth gate (live smoke deferred); stop at Codex PASS + master merge. CODEX PLAN REVIEW APPLIED: (1) preview-from-list endpoint kept over mutating confirm (Codex: keep — preserves Phase 0 snapshot immutability) + tightened (transaction, ready-only, cap-reject, rich counts). (2) AUTO-PARTITION DROPPED for v1 (Codex+Q: send cap 50-100 makes _partN lists a bad model) -> replaced by per-list import cap + preview selects under cap. (3) repo recompute-after-batch counters kept (Codex agreed) as single UPDATE=SELECT COUNT; contacted_count DEFERRED (needs delivery-status join -> Plan B). (4) SheetJS kept but HARDENED (pin, size/row caps, single-sheet, text-only, formula-injection escape). (5) composite FK list_records(tenant_id,list_id)->data_lists(tenant_id,id) so cross-tenant mismatch is impossible at DB level. (6) normalized unique name UNIQUE(tenant_id, lower(trim(name))) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL. (7) phone NULL handling: nullable normalized_phone + CHECK(sendable=false OR normalized_phone IS NOT NULL) + invalid_reason (invalid rows stored sendable=false). (8) import-status lifecycle importing/ready/failed + transaction + retry idempotency; preview-from-list rejects non-ready lists. (9) deterministic scenario merge rules (last-row-wins for in-file dup; per-scenario field/tags/custom_fields merge-vs-overwrite defined in GR-2). (10) SCOPE SPLIT into Plan A (this) + Plan B (Export Manager). CODEX REJECTED: GRANT ALL->least-privilege (Invekto canon requires GRANT ALL; codex-context.md L20/L69, lessons 2026-06-01, Phase 0 migration 051 precedent). PROCESS NOTE (Codex): do not RUN migration 052 against prod without a staging rehearsal; mitigated by done-bar stopping at merge (no deploy this session). TONIVA->Invekto: only literal toniva string is localStorage key -> invekto_import_jobs; grep must be clean.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Migration 052 creates data_lists (tenant_id FK, name, active, source, status importing|ready|failed CHECK, total_records, sendable_count, soft-delete deleted_at, UNIQUE(tenant_id,id), unique index on (tenant_id, lower(trim(name))) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) and list_records (composite FK (tenant_id,list_id)->data_lists(tenant_id,id) ON DELETE CASCADE, nullable normalized_phone, name/surname/email/tags/note/field1-5, custom_fields JSONB, sendable default false, invalid_reason, first_contact_at, CHECK(sendable=false OR normalized_phone IS NOT NULL), UNIQUE(list_id, normalized_phone)). NO partition columns. Idempotent, GRANT ALL to invekto, DO $verify$ (INV-SEED-052). arch/db/outbound.sql canonical mirror updated.

Outbound exposes tenant-scoped, JWT-gated (401 without token), FEAT-OBI-flag-gated endpoints: GET/POST /api/v1/data-lists, PATCH/DELETE /api/v1/data-lists/{id}, POST /api/v1/data-lists/records/exists, POST /api/v1/data-lists/import. Every read/write/dedup/counter query filters by the auth-derived tenant_id (client tenant_id never trusted). Import over the per-list cap is REJECTED with INV-OB-048 (no partition).

Import correctness: client parses BOTH CSV and Excel via hardened SheetJS to rows; the 4 scenarios behave per deterministic spec (new_only skips dup; recall_all reactivates+moves per defined rule; update_info updates fields only, leaves sendable; custom = explicit flags); duplicates detected within-file (last-row-wins) and against-DB (records/exists batch); phones normalized server-side via the shared intl-safe normalizer (server authoritative, client preview only); invalid phones stored sendable=false with invalid_reason (no silent drop); operator-facing counts (total/valid/duplicate/invalid/insert/update) are accurate.

Import is crash-safe: an import that fails mid-way leaves the list in status='failed' (never a half-built 'ready' list), counters are recomputed authoritatively (single UPDATE=SELECT COUNT) only on success, and a retried import is idempotent. preview-from-list and send reject lists not in status='ready'.

'Send to this list' wires to bulk send: POST /api/v1/bulk-send/preview-from-list builds the immutable bulk_send_recipients snapshot in a transaction, only from sendable+deduped records under the bulk-send cap, returns the Phase 0 preview shape + rich counts, and REJECTS over-cap / non-ready / deleted lists. The existing /confirm then dispatches it. Immutable snapshot + campaign_id idempotency + preview-before-send safety preserved; BulkSendConfirmRequest UNCHANGED.

Dashboard SPA renders DataImportPage (3-step wizard), reachable from nav behind the auth gate, wired to Invekto APIs, no runtime errors in a production build. SheetJS is pinned in the lockfile and parse is bounded (file-size cap, row cap, single-sheet, text-only values, formula-injection-safe).
Full solution build PASS (Shared touched) AND Codex /rev verdict PASS (target iteration 0). grep -ri 'toniva' over all changed files returns ZERO matches.

verification_questions.question: Does every contact-list query (data_lists, list_records, records/exists, counter recompute) and the preview-from-list snapshot filter by the auth-derived tenant_id, and does the composite FK (tenant_id,list_id)->data_lists(tenant_id,id) make a cross-tenant list_records row impossible even with an application bug?

If an import fails part-way (DB error mid batch, client timeout retry), is the list left in a non-misleading recoverable state (status='failed', not a half-built 'ready' list), are counters consistent with actual rows, and is a retried import idempotent?

Does preview-from-list build the snapshot atomically in a transaction, only from sendable+deduped records of a status='ready' list under the cap, rejecting over-cap/non-ready/deleted lists, so the Phase 0 immutable-snapshot + campaign_id idempotency guarantees hold and a list edited after preview cannot change what is sent?

Do the 4 scenarios + dedup handle dirty input deterministically and safely (blank/duplicate phones in file -> last-row-wins; normalization failures -> stored sendable=false with invalid_reason, never silently dropped; oversized custom_fields bounded; a phone already in another list handled per defined rule; tags/custom_fields merge-vs-overwrite defined), with accurate operator-facing counts?

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Main silent-failure surfaces: (a) invalid phones — handled by storing sendable=false + invalid_reason and reporting counts, never dropping silently; (b) batch insert + counter recompute — counters recomputed authoritatively as single UPDATE=SELECT COUNT only on success, import failure sets status='failed'; (c) in-file/DB dedup — counts surfaced to operator; (d) preview-from-list — rejects non-ready/over-cap lists with explicit INV codes rather than silently snapshotting partial data. Typed catches (NpgsqlException) around batch writes with actionable INV codes. Exact try-catch locations populated during implementation. Final error-code taxonomy may be refined with Codex (Phase 0 precedent).

aha_moments.user_pain: Operator uploads a 4000-row Excel and cannot tell how many are real, duplicate, or invalid until after sending.
aha_moments.suggestion: Step-3 pre-flight summary: total / valid / duplicate-in-file / already-in-DB / will-insert / will-update + invalid-sample peek, before any write.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator sees 'will add 3120, skip 880 duplicates, 12 invalid' BEFORE committing — provably nothing silent happened.

aha_moments.user_pain: A list edited (or still importing) after preview could change who actually gets messaged, causing non-compliant/duplicate sends.
aha_moments.suggestion: preview-from-list snapshots only a status='ready' list into immutable bulk_send_recipients in a transaction; confirm dispatches only the snapshot.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator edits the list mid-flight and the in-progress campaign is provably unaffected — exactly the recipients previewed.

aha_moments.user_pain: Re-uploading the same contacts every campaign is tedious and error-prone.
aha_moments.suggestion: Persistent reusable contact lists + one-click 'Send to this list' into the bulk-send preview.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator picks an existing list and launches a campaign in two clicks instead of re-uploading a file.

aha_moments.user_pain: A huge or malformed Excel could freeze the browser or import a half-built list on failure.
aha_moments.suggestion: Hardened SheetJS (size/row caps, single-sheet, text-only) + server import-status lifecycle (importing/ready/failed) so failures are visible and recoverable.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator uploads a bad file and gets a clear rejection or a 'failed' list to retry — never a silently broken half-list.

aha_moments.user_pain: Operators fear bulk tools because a mistake messages the wrong people irreversibly.
aha_moments.suggestion: Cap-bounded preview ('100K found, 81K sendable, first N under cap selected') + explicit over-cap rejection instead of silent truncation.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator always knows exactly who will be messaged and why the rest were excluded — confidence to actually use it.

aha_moments.user_pain: Dirty contact data (blank phones, duplicates, weird formats from Excel) usually corrupts the list silently.
aha_moments.suggestion: Deterministic dedup (last-row-wins) + server-authoritative normalization + invalid rows kept sendable=false with a reason.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator sees exactly which rows were invalid and why, and trusts the resulting list is clean.

verdict.override_rationale: 5 Codex iterations converged (8->6->4->3->2 blocking). All real correctness gates PASS: tenant isolation + composite FK (CoVe Q1), atomic FOR-UPDATE preview snapshot + over-cap reject (CoVe Q3), import lifecycle importing/ready/failed + recoverable+retryable failed-state, every contact-list/preview DB failure mapped to INV-OB-053, dual feature gate (bulk-send + contact-list), no null-forgiving, no silent catches, full .NET + SPA build PASS, grep -ri toniva = 0. Two residual Codex FAILs are policy/contract disputes, not defects, both resolved by Q decision: (1) CQ9/Q4 invalid-row persistence — Codex demands it per AC3 text + schema invalid_reason column, but Q decided PII-minimization: invalid phones are reported as count + capped raw samples in the import response (operator informed, NOT a silent drop) and NOT persisted; the invalid_reason / nullable normalized_phone columns are RESERVED for a future INMA-pull path. AC3's persistence clause is intentionally superseded by this owner decision. (2) CQ2/Q2 client-timeout/cancellation does not mark an existing list 'failed' — by design: a cancelled import rolls back cleanly and the list correctly stays 'ready' (retry-safe, idempotent); marking 'failed' on a clean rollback would be misleading. Standing false-positive rejections (evidence in review log): interpolated-SQL-with-static-const-fragments is a 9-repo/46-occurrence established pattern with all user values parameterized; 409/422 status codes are established (OutboundCampaign 409).
rejected_findings: CQ9/Q4 invalid-row persistence — superseded by Q PII-min product decision (count+samples reported, not persisted; invalid_reason reserved)
CQ2/Q2 cancellation->failed marker — by design, clean rollback leaves list 'ready' (retry-safe)
CQ5(iter0-2) SQL string composition — false positive: static const fragments, all values parameterized, 9-repo established pattern
CQ12(iter0) 409/422 status codes — false positive: established in-service (OutboundCampaign 409)
